Plot CytoTRACE 2 Results

Source: R/CytoTRACEPlot.R
CytoTRACEPlot.Rd

Plot CytoTRACE 2 Results

Usage

CytoTRACEPlot(
  srt,
  reduction = NULL,
  group.by = NULL,
  combine = TRUE,
  nrow = NULL,
  ncol = NULL,
  byrow = TRUE,
  pt.size = NULL,
  pt.alpha = 1,
  palette = "Chinese",
  palcolor = NULL,
  theme_use = "theme_scop",
  theme_args = list(),
  verbose = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

srt

A Seurat object.

reduction

Reduction to plot. NULL uses DefaultReduction.

group.by

Metadata column(s) used to color cells.

combine, nrow, ncol, byrow

Combine plots with patchwork. combine = FALSE returns a list of ggplots.

pt.size, pt.alpha

Point size and transparency. pt.size = NULL scales with sqrt(n) (minimum 0.3). Rasterized points keep at least a two-pixel radius at raster.dpi = c(512, 512) and scale with raster.dpi.

palette, palcolor

Palette name (thisplot::show_palettes) or custom colors.

theme_use, theme_args

Theme name or function, plus extra theme arguments.

verbose

Whether to print the message. Default is TRUE.

...

Passed to CellDimPlot and FeatureDimPlot.

Value

If combine = TRUE, returns a patchwork object combining all plots. If combine = FALSE, returns a named list of ggplot objects:

  • Score: UMAP plot colored by score computed by CytoTRACE2;

  • Potency: UMAP plot colored by potency category computed by CytoTRACE2;

  • Relative: UMAP plot colored by relative score computed by CytoTRACE2;

  • Phenotype: UMAP plot colored by phenotype (if group.by is provided);

  • Boxplot: Boxplot of score computed by CytoTRACE2 corresponding to phenotype (if group.by is provided).

See also

RunCytoTRACE, CellDimPlot, FeatureDimPlot

Examples

data(pancreas_sub)
pancreas_sub <- RunStandardWorkflow(pancreas_sub)
#> ℹ [2026-09-05 15:47:02] Start standard processing workflow...
#> ℹ [2026-09-05 15:47:02] Checking a list of <Seurat>...
#> ! [2026-09-05 15:47:02] Data 1/1 of the `srt_list` is "unknown"
#> ℹ [2026-09-05 15:47:02] Perform `NormalizeData()` with `normalization.method = 'LogNormalize'` on 1/1 of `srt_list`...
#> ℹ [2026-09-05 15:47:02] Perform `FindVariableFeatures()` on 1/1 of `srt_list`...
#> ℹ [2026-09-05 15:47:02] Use the separate HVF from `srt_list`
#> ℹ [2026-09-05 15:47:02] Number of available HVF: 2000
#> ℹ [2026-09-05 15:47:02] Finished check
#> ℹ [2026-09-05 15:47:02] Perform `ScaleData()`
#> ℹ [2026-09-05 15:47:03] Perform pca linear dimension reduction
#> ℹ [2026-09-05 15:47:03] Use stored estimated dimensions 1:23 for Standardpca
#> ℹ [2026-09-05 15:47:03] Perform `Seurat::FindClusters()` with `cluster_algorithm = 'louvain'` and `cluster_resolution = 0.6`

pancreas_sub <- RunCytoTRACE(
  pancreas_sub,
  species = "Mus_musculus",
  backend = "cpp"
)
#> ◌ [2026-09-05 15:47:12] Running CytoTRACE2
#> ℹ [2026-09-05 15:47:12] Extracting expression matrix from `assay = RNA, layer = counts`

#> ℹ [2026-09-05 15:47:14] Species: "Homo_sapiens"
#> ℹ [2026-09-05 15:47:14] Species: "Mus_musculus"
#> ℹ [2026-09-05 15:47:14] Loading model from /home/runner/.local/share/R/scop/CytoTRACE2

CytoTRACEPlot(
  pancreas_sub,
  group.by = "CellType",
  xlab = "UMAP_1",
  ylab = "UMAP_2"
)


plots <- CytoTRACEPlot(
  pancreas_sub,
  group.by = "CellType",
  combine = FALSE
)
plots$Boxplot
